school: 全真道/龙门派（以苦修立身、一言止杀、掌管天下道教的金末蒙初全真七子之一）
historical_significance: 丘处机（1148-1227），字通密，号长春子，登州栖霞人，全真七子之一、龙门派创始人。十九岁入道师从王重阳，1174年后于磻溪、龙门苦修六年，日乞一食、胁不沾席，以苦行立信。金世宗、南宋宁宗先后征召皆辞不赴；1219年冬，年逾七十一闻成吉思汗诏，率尹志平、李志常等十八弟子自莱州启程西行，历蒙古高原、金山、大漠，行程万余里，1222年抵大雪山（今兴都库什山）三次晋见成吉思汗，进言'敬天爱民为本、清心寡欲为要'，屡以止杀为言，史称'一言止杀'。太祖深契其言，命左右书之训示诸子，赐虎符玺书，掌管天下道教，蠲免道人差发赋税。东归后居燕京太极宫（改称长春宫），广建宫观、持玺书救俘济民、放度牒收容流民，全真教由此鼎盛为北方最大道门。弟子李志常随行所记《长春真人西游记》二卷，逐日记程道里、山川风俗与召对问答，为元代中亚地理与蒙初宗教政策的第一手文献。1227年逝世，葬白云观处顺堂；生前指定尹志平嗣掌教，以制度安排延续教门。其'万里一言'的进言范式、乱世中把教团做成秩序的组织方略，与以善举为传播的济世路线，构成中国宗教史上罕见的'行动的宗教家'形象。
historical_significance_en: Qiu Chuji (1148-1227), courtesy name Tongmi, style Changchunzi ('Perfected Spring'), a native of Qixia in Dengzhou, one of the Seven Perfected of Quanzhen and founder of the Dragon Gate lineage. He entered the way at nineteen under Wang Zhongyang; after 1174 he practiced six years of austerity at Panxi and Dragon Gate, one bowl begged daily, never lying full length, founding his credit on ascetic life. Summoned in turn by Emperor Shizong of Jin and Emperor Ningzong of Southern Song, he declined them both; in the winter of 1219, past seventy, on hearing the summons of Genghis Khan he set out at once with eighteen disciples including Yin Zhiping and Li Zhichang from Laizhou, westward across the Mongolian steppe, the Altai and the desert, more than ten thousand li, reaching the Hindu Kush in 1222 for three audiences with the khan, counseling 'revere heaven and love the people as the root; purify the heart and few desires as the essential', pressing again and again for an end to slaughter — history's 'one word that stayed the killing'. The khan was deeply moved, ordered it written down to instruct his sons, granted the tiger tally and sealed letter, set him over all Daoism under heaven, and remitted clergy taxes and corvée. Back east he dwelt at the Taiji Palace in Yanjing (renamed Changchun Palace), built abbeys widely, ransomed captives and relieved refugees under the sealed letter, issued ordinations and took in the displaced — Quanzhen rose to be the greatest Daoist school of the north. His disciple Li Zhichang, traveling with him, wrote the Journey to the West of the Perfected Changchun in two fascicles, logging each day the stages, mountains and customs, the questions and answers of the audiences — a firsthand source for Yuan-era Central Asian geography and early Mongol religious policy. He died in 1227, buried at Chushun Hall of the White Cloud Temple, having named Yin Zhiping heir to the leadership and settled the school's future by institutional design. His paradigm of 'ten thousand li for one word', his strategy of making the school itself an order amid chaos, and his way of preaching through good works compose the rare figure in Chinese religious history of a man of action in religion.
unique_thinking: 丘处机思维模式的独特性在于'把进言做成工程、把存续做成制度'的双重设计：(1)窗口思维——识别一生只有一次的进言窗口，以七旬之身行万里路，让行程本身为言语背书，把'劝谏'升格为权力无法拒绝的'事件'；(2)杠杆思维——不求财货求原则，让'止杀'被权力亲口认领并写入训条，用最小的请求撬动最大的保护，且保护可跨代执行；(3)乱世秩序思维——不避世而入世，以戒律、宫观、善举把教团做成流民可投奔的'可依赖的小秩序'，组织因被乱世需要而壮大；(4)信用工程思维——以身先士卒的可视化苦行为一切要求预付抵押，权威不靠说教靠示范；(5)传承制度思维——受赏时把荣宠兑换成蠲免赋役等书面政策，提前指定并历练继承人，使一句进言的效力延续百年。他证明：面对最强的权力，弱者最大的筹码不是资源，而是时机、原则与信用。
unique_thinking_en: The distinctiveness of Qiu Chuji's thinking lies in a double design — 'making counsel an engineering project, making survival an institution': (1) window thinking — identify the one chance in a lifetime to speak, walk ten thousand li past seventy so the journey itself underwrites the word, upgrading counsel into an event power cannot refuse; (2) lever thinking — ask not for treasure but for principle, have 'spare the slaughter' claimed by power's own mouth and written into its precepts, the smallest request levering the greatest protection, and a protection that outlives its grantor; (3) order-in-chaos thinking — not withdrawing from the world but entering it, using precepts, abbeys and good works to make the school a dependable small order refugees flee to, an organization grown great because the chaos needed it; (4) credit engineering — visible ascetic discipline paid in advance as collateral for every demand, authority resting on example, not sermon; (5) institutional succession — at the hour of reward exchange favor for written policy such as tax remission, name and school the heir early, carrying one spoken word's force a hundred years onward. He proved that facing the strongest power, the weak's greatest stakes are not resources but timing, principle and credit.
civilization_zh: 金末蒙初的乱世道门：丘处机（1148-1227），字通密，号长春子，登州栖霞人，全真七子之一、龙门派创始人；十九岁入道师从王重阳，磻溪、龙门六年苦修；金与南宋屡征不就，1219年冬年逾七十一诏启行，率十八弟子自莱州西行万里，经蒙古高原、越金山、过大漠，1222年抵大雪山（兴都库什山）三见成吉思汗，进言'敬天爱民为本、清心寡欲为要'，史称'一言止杀'；东归后居燕京太极宫（改称长春宫），奉诏掌管天下道教，蠲免道人赋役，广建宫观、收容流民；1227年逝世，葬白云观处顺堂；弟子李志常记行程问答为《长春真人西游记》，为元代中亚地理与蒙初宗教政策第一手文献
civilization_en: The world of Daoist schools amid the Jin-Mongol transition: Qiu Chuji (1148-1227), courtesy name Tongmi, style Changchunzi, a native of Qixia in Dengzhou, one of the Seven Perfected of Quanzhen and founder of the Dragon Gate lineage; he entered the way at nineteen under Wang Zhongyang and practiced six years of austerity at Panxi and Dragon Gate; summoned repeatedly by Jin and Southern Song, he declined them all, but at the winter of 1219, past seventy, set out on the Great Khan's single summons with eighteen disciples from Laizhou, westward ten thousand li across the Mongolian steppe, over the Altai, through the desert, reaching the Hindu Kush in 1222 for three audiences with Genghis Khan, counseling 'revere heaven and love the people as the root, purify the heart and few desires as the essential' — history's 'one word that stayed the slaughter'; returning east he dwelt at the Taiji Palace in Yanjing (renamed Changchun Palace), charged with all Daoism under heaven, winning remission of clergy taxes, building abbeys widely and sheltering refugees; he died in 1227, buried at Chushun Hall in the White Cloud Temple; his disciple Li Zhichang recorded the journey and audiences as the Journey to the West of the Perfected Changchun, a firsthand source for Yuan-era Central Asian geography and early Mongol religious policy
roles_en: Founder of the Dragon Gate lineage
One of the Seven Perfected of Quanzhen
key_works: 《长春真人西游记》（弟子李志常记）
雪山论道进言（载《元史·丘处机传》）

cross_references.description_zh: 丘处机与司马迁同以'行走的记录'对抗遗忘而对象相反：司马迁行走天下是为了把过去写进历史，丘处机西行万里时让弟子逐日记录是为了把当下留给未来。《长春真人西游记》与《史记》同属'行走的档案'传统——历史不只来自书斋的整理，更来自脚步与笔的同步。
cross_references.description_en: Qiu Chuji and Sima Qian both fought forgetting with 'the walking record', toward opposite objects: Sima Qian walked the realm to write the past into history, while Qiu, marching west, had his disciple log each day to hand the present to the future. The Journey to the West of the Perfected Changchun and the Records of the Grand Historian belong to one tradition of 'the walking archive' — history comes not only from the study's sorting but from footsteps and brush in step.

cross_references.description_zh: 丘处机与莲花生同以'教团与权力的接口设计'传法存教：莲花生入吐蕃以密法收编苯教神祇，把阻力转化为护法；丘处机赴大雪山以'敬天爱民'接口收编草原权力，把征服者转化为教团的保护人。两人都证明了：传教者最大的道场不在山林，而在与权力对话的那张桌子上。
cross_references.description_en: Qiu Chuji and Padmasambhava both designed the interface between school and power to plant their teachings: Padmasambhava entered Tibet subsuming Bon deities under the dharma, turning resistance into guardianship; Qiu went to the Hindu Kush and interfaced with steppe power through 'revere heaven, love the people', turning the conqueror into the school's patron. Both proved the preacher's greatest sanctuary is not the mountain grove but the table where power is spoken with.

cross_references.description_zh: 丘处机与马可·奥勒留同为'权力的对话者'而方向两极：奥勒留在权力内部以《沉思录》自我审计，约束的是自己；丘处在权力外部以万里之行进言止杀，约束的是他人。一个证明内省可以撑起德政的底线，一个证明外人的一句话也可能改写征服的路线。
cross_references.description_en: Qiu Chuji and Marcus Aurelius, both interlocutors of power, faced opposite directions: Aurelius, inside power, audited himself in the Meditations, binding himself; Qiu, outside power, walked ten thousand li to counsel the khan to spare the slaughter, binding others. One proved introspection can hold the floor of virtue in government; the other, that an outsider's single word may yet bend the route of conquest.

cross_references.description_zh: 丘处机与香农同关'如何以最小的信息达成最大的效果'而载体相反：香农把信息压缩到极致以通过信道，丘处机把一生的进言压缩成'止杀'一言以通过权力的耳朵——前者追求比特的最小冗余，后者追求言语的最小剂量最大杠杆，共同揭示'少即是多'的信息论本质。
cross_references.description_en: Qiu Chuji and Claude Shannon, both concerned with achieving the greatest effect from the least information, chose opposite carriers: Shannon compressed messages to pass the channel; Qiu compressed a lifetime of counsel into the single word 'spare the killing' to pass the ear of power — one pursued minimal redundancy of bits, the other minimal dosage with maximal leverage of speech; together they reveal the information-theoretic essence that less is more.

modes.name_en: The Method of the Ten-Thousand-Li Journey for One Word
modes.domain_zh: 当唯一的机会窗口出现时，不计年龄、路程与风险，把全部筹码押在'当面说一句话'上——用行走的万里证明所言的分量，让劝谏本身成为不可拒绝的事件
modes.domain_en: When the one and only window of opportunity opens, stake everything — age, distance, danger — on 'saying one word face to face'; the ten thousand li walked become proof of the word's weight, making the counsel itself an event that cannot be refused
modes.source_chapter: 1219年冬年逾七十应成吉思汗诏，自山东莱州启程，历时约两年、行程万里，于1222年抵大雪山（兴都库什山）与成吉思汗论道；弟子李志常《长春真人西游记》记其全程
modes.key_quote_zh: 但道行言，则天上神仙皆可致……千秋万世，徒闻其名；一日之遇，垂之无穷
modes.key_quote_en: 'Only let the way be traveled and the word be spoken... a thousand autumns may pass with the name merely heard; but one day's meeting endures without end.'
process_zh: 识别一生只有一次的窗口：权力巅峰者主动发出邀请而尚未关闭的时刻，判断错过即永失
不计代价应召：年龄、健康、路途凶险都纳入成本而非理由——窗口价值远超个人安危
把行路本身做成论证：行程的艰难公开可见，使抵达时'所言'已被'所行'背书
抓住当面唯一时机集中输出：不做日常渗透，把全部要点压缩在少数几次召对中说尽
process_en: Identify the once-in-a-lifetime window: the moment power's summit invites and the door is not yet closed; judge that missing it means losing it forever
Answer the summons regardless of cost: age, health and perils of the road are costs, not reasons — the window outweighs personal safety
Make the journey itself the argument: its hardships are publicly visible, so that on arrival 'what is said' is already underwritten by 'what was walked'
Concentrate output on the few audiences granted: no daily infiltration; compress every essential point into those few face-to-face moments
representative_cases_zh: 1219年金与南宋先后征召皆不赴，而成吉思汗一诏即行：丘处机判断蒙古将是天下新主，且大汗亲召是儒道两家百年一遇的进言窗口
以七十余高龄率十八弟子自莱州启程，穿蒙古高原、越金山（阿尔泰山）、渡阴山，行经万余里——途中多次以年迈请求缓期被拒仍坚行
1222年于大雪山三次论道，'一言止杀'的进言全部集中在召对中完成；归后成吉思汗赐虎符玺书、掌管天下道教——一句话换了整个教门的生存空间
representative_cases_en: In 1219 he declined summons from both Jin and Southern Song but set out at once on the Great Khan's: he judged the Mongols the coming masters of the world, and a khan's personal summons a once-in-a-century window to speak

Past seventy, he led eighteen disciples from Laizhou across the Mongolian steppe, over the Altai and the Yin Mountains, more than ten thousand li — pleas of old age for delay were refused, and he pressed on

At the Hindu Kush in 1222 three audiences delivered all his counsel — the 'one word that stayed the slaughter' was spent entirely in those sittings; the khan then granted the tiger tally and seal, placing all Daoism under him: one word bought the school its living space
modern_applications_zh: 关键客户只给一次提案机会：把全公司的准备压缩进那一次当面的三十分钟，而非分散于长年邮件
个人职业的关键窗口（上市、并购、换届）：判断哪些机会一生只来一次，果断押上全部积累
对最高决策者的谏言：不写长篇备忘，争取当面十分钟——到场本身就是最大的论据
modern_applications_en: A key client grants one pitch: compress the whole firm's preparation into that single thirty-minute meeting, not scattered across years of email
Career-defining windows — IPOs, mergers, successions: judge which chances come once in a lifetime and stake your whole accumulation on them
Counsel to the top decision-maker: not a long memo but ten minutes in the room — showing up is itself the strongest argument

modes.name_en: The Method of the One-Word Lever
modes.domain_zh: 不向权力要资源、要地位，只争取一条能撬动全局的原则性承诺——用最少的请求撬动最大的保护：'请勿杀'一句胜过千顷田产，因为原则一旦被权力亲口认领，就成了权力自己的招牌
modes.domain_en: Ask power not for resources or rank but for one principled undertaking that levers the whole situation — the smallest request moves the greatest protection: 'spare the killing' outweighs a thousand acres, for once power itself claims the principle, the principle becomes power's own banner
modes.source_chapter: 1222-1223年大雪山论道，进言'敬天爱民为本''清心寡欲为要'，屡以止杀为言；《元史·丘处机传》载'太祖深契其言，命左右书之，且以训诸子'
modes.key_quote_zh: 一天下者，必在乎不嗜杀人
modes.key_quote_en: 'He who would unify the world must not delight in killing.'
process_zh: 从千头万绪中提炼唯一要害：判断当下最大的恶是什么（屠城），把全部请求收敛为对它的制止
把请求包装成权力的利益而非恩赐：'不嗜杀者得天下'——让止杀成为征服者的功业策略
争取当众确认：请大汗命左右书之、训示诸子，使承诺变为可传的记录与制度
以承诺为凭据长期兑现：归后持玺书到处拯救俘虏流民，每救一人都是那条原则的执行
process_en: Distill from ten thousand threads the single vital point: name the greatest evil of the hour — the massacre of cities — and converge every request upon stopping it
Frame the request as power's interest, not charity: 'he who delights not in killing wins the world' — restraint becomes the conqueror's own strategy of success
Win public confirmation: have the khan order it written and instruct his heirs, turning a promise into record and institution
Cash the promise for years: bearing the sealed letter he rescued captives and refugees everywhere — every life saved an execution of that one principle
representative_cases_zh: 三次论道不谈一己一教之利，专陈'外修阴德、内固精神''恤民保众使天下怀安'：把教门存亡置换为天下存亡的议题
《元史》载太祖'命左右书之，且以训诸子'：把口头承诺固化为蒙古宫廷的书面训条，丘处机深谙'写下来的话才活得住'
归燕后住太极宫（长春宫），凭成吉思汗给的玺书广发度牒、庇护降民与道众：蒙古兵锋所至，持长春真人符牒者多获免——一句承诺变成千万人的免死牌
representative_cases_en: In the three audiences he spoke not one word of his school's advantage, only of 'outer cultivation of hidden virtue, inner settling of spirit' and 'cherishing the people that the world may rest': the school's survival was recast as the world's question

The History of Yuan records the khan 'ordered his attendants to write it down and instruct his sons with it': an oral promise fixed as a written precept of the Mongol court — Chiu knew only written words survive

Back in Yan at the Palace of Great Equanimity (Changchun Palace) he issued ordination certificates under the khan's sealed letter and sheltered surrendered folk and clerics: where Mongol arms reached, many were spared who carried his talisman — one promise grown into ten thousand exemptions
modern_applications_zh: 谈判只锁定一条不可让步的原则并让对方公开背书：一次高规格确认胜过十个私下默契
公益组织向企业要承诺不要捐款：'写入公司章程的减排条款'比一次性资金产生十年杠杆
个人向上级争取授权：不争资源争一条'遇此类事可先斩后奏'的书面授权——原则性授权可复用
modern_applications_en: In negotiation lock one non-negotiable principle and have the other side endorse it publicly: one high-level confirmation beats ten private understandings
Nonprofits ask corporations for commitments, not donations: an emissions clause written into the charter levers a decade beyond one-off funds
When seeking authority from above, ask not for resources but for one written mandate — 'in such matters act first, report after': a principled mandate is reusable

modes.name_en: The Method of the School's Survival in Chaos
modes.domain_zh: 在王朝崩解、兵锋四出的时代，教团存续不靠避世而靠'在乱局中把自己做成秩序'：立戒律、兴宫观、行善举，让教门成为流民可投奔的庇护所——组织越是被乱世需要，越能乱世中存续并壮大
modes.domain_en: In an age of collapsing dynasties and roving armies, a school survives not by withdrawing from the world but by 'becoming order within the chaos': establish precepts, build abbeys, practice charity, make the teaching a refuge refugees can flee to — the more an organization is needed by the chaos, the more it survives and grows amid it
modes.source_chapter: 金末山东大乱，丘处机主持登州、莱州全真教务，立观度人；1214年山东杨安儿之乱，丘处机招抚登州、宁海民众多所全活；此后广建宫观、收容流民
modes.key_quote_en: 'Incense from the ten quarters, a teaching's air across the four seas.'
process_zh: 把组织的价值锚在乱世的稀缺品上：安全、粮食、规矩——不锚在太平年代的功名利禄上
以戒律立内秩序：教团内部先成为可以信赖的小社会，才谈得上向外输出秩序
广行救济吸纳流民：饥馑兵灾中开仓赈济、收留孤幼，被救者即教团最深的根基
借当权者的合法性外壳扩展：取得官方符牒与度牒发行权，把民间信任与官方法理接通
process_en: Anchor the organization's value on what chaos makes scarce — safety, food, rules — not on the prizes of peaceful times
Found inner order on discipline: only when the school itself is a trustworthy little society can it export order outward
Absorb refugees through wide relief: opening granaries in famine, taking in orphans — the saved become the school's deepest foundation
Scale under legitimacy's shell: win official tallies and the right to issue ordination papers, joining popular trust to official law
representative_cases_zh: 1214年山东杨安儿起义，金廷请丘处机招抚：他凭个人威望使登州、宁海等地不战而安——乱世中'教门信用'成为官方买不到的治理资源
掌教期间广建宫观，全真教宫观网络扩展至山东、河北、河南：每一座宫观既是道场也是乱世中的堡垒与粮仓
得到成吉思汗玺书后'凡将帅来谒，必先劝以不杀'，并放度为道者以千计：把征服战争的流离人口转化为教团人口，教团成为最大赢家之一
representative_cases_en: In 1214, amid Yang An'er's rising in Shandong, the Jin court asked him to pacify: on his personal standing Dengzhou and Ninghai calmed without battle — in chaos, the school's credibility became governance the state could not buy
Under his leadership the Quanzhen abbey network spread across Shandong, Hebei and Henan: each abbey at once a sanctuary and, in troubled times, a fortress and granary

With the khan's sealed letter he 'urged every visiting general first toward not killing' and issued ordinations by the thousand: the flotsam of conquest became the school's population — the teaching among the great winners of the war
modern_applications_zh: 危机中的企业定位：把产品锚在'乱世刚需'（安全、续命、信任）上，衰退期反而是扩张期
社区组织在灾荒与动荡中建立'可依赖的小秩序'：谁先提供确定性，谁就获得人心与人才
平台型组织在监管窗口期取得官方牌照：把民间信任与法理外壳接通，风暴来临时多一层护甲
modern_applications_en: Position a firm on what crisis makes essential — safety, survival, trust: downturn becomes expansion season
Community organizations build 'a dependable small order' in disaster and turmoil: whoever supplies certainty first wins hearts and talent
Platform organizations win licenses in regulatory windows: joining popular trust to legal shell adds armor before the storm
representative_figures: 丘处机（核心）
王重阳（先行：立三教合一之制、创全真组织框架的教团奠基者）
本笃（同构：修道院成为罗马崩解后的文明庇护所）
稻盛和夫（对照：以'敬天爱人'哲学在破产潮中重建组织的现代同构）
modes.definition_zh: 在王朝崩解、兵锋四出的时代，教团存续不靠避世而靠'在乱局中把自己做成秩序'：立戒律、兴宫观、行善举，让教门成为流民可投奔的庇护所——组织越是被乱世需要，越能乱世中存续并壮大
modes.definition_en: In an age of collapsing dynasties and roving armies, a school survives not by withdrawing from the world but by 'becoming order within the chaos': establish precepts, build abbeys, practice charity, make the teaching a refuge refugees can flee to — the more an organization is needed by the chaos, the more it survives and grows amid it

modes.domain_zh: 以长期自我克制与身体力行的苦修作为'信用的抵押物'：让追随者与对手都看见你先于他人承受了代价——领袖的权威不来自说教而来自'我先做到了'的可视化证明
modes.domain_en: Long self-restraint and bodily practice are pledged as collateral for credibility: let followers and rivals alike see that you bore the cost before demanding it of others — a leader's authority comes not from preaching but from visible proof that 'I did it first'
modes.source_chapter: 青年于磻溪、龙门两度苦修六年，'昼夜不寐者六年'，胁不沾席；后立教规，行乞炼心；《金莲正宗记》等全真史料记其苦行
modes.key_quote_zh: 饥饿只能吃一钵面，寒冷只能穿蓑衣——苦行非苦行，是给众人看的信用凭证
modes.key_quote_en: 'In hunger, one bowl of flour; in cold, straw cloak — asceticism is not suffering but a bond of trust displayed before all.'
process_zh: 选择最艰苦且最可见的修行方式：苦要苦在人前，把'我承受过'变成公共事实
以六年为期的长期主义：短期表演骗不过人，跨年度的一致性才构成信用
要求他人之前先立自身样板：立戒时自己已经过了更严的版本
把苦行转译为教义而非个人英雄主义：'打炼心性'的方法论化，让弟子可复制
process_en: Choose the harshest and most visible practice: suffer where it can be seen, making 'I have borne it' a public fact
Commit on the scale of years: short stints deceive no one; only consistency across years compounds into credit
Set the exemplar before the demand: when laying down precepts, you have already lived a stricter version
Translate asceticism into doctrine, not heroics: 'refining the mind' methodized so disciples can copy it
representative_cases_zh: 1168-1174年间先在磻溪、后在龙门洞苦修：日乞一食、胁不沾席、寒暑不易——全真教内'丘长春苦行'成为衡量后学的标尺
掌教后教团戒律严明、宫观清规整肃：他立的规矩他自己先以六年苦行验证过，弟子无从质疑
西行途中与弟子同甘苦、以高龄冒风雪先行：万里之行本身就是苦行的延续，途中不断积累教团内外对其个人的敬畏
representative_cases_en: Between 1168 and 1174 he practiced first at Panxi, then at Dragon Gate: one bowl begged daily, never lying on his side through cold and heat — 'Changchun's asceticism' became the measure for all who followed
As master he kept the school's discipline strict and its abbeys orderly: the rules he laid down he had already lived for six years in harsher form — disciples had no ground to object

On the western journey he shared every hardship, an old man leading through blizzards: the ten-thousand-li march itself an extension of the ascetic life, piling awe upon him within and beyond the school
modern_applications_zh: 创业领导力：要求团队艰苦奋斗前，创始人先公开自己的'苦行记录'（降薪、驻场、还款）
专业信誉建设：把从业中的困难项目做成可查证的公开记录——'我淋过雨'是收费能力的一部分
教育训练：训练者先完成自己布置的科目并公示成绩，标准才有说服力
modern_applications_en: Founder leadership: before demanding hardship of the team, publish your own record — pay cuts, on-site months, debts repaid
Professional reputation: turn hard projects into verifiable public record — 'I have been rained on' is part of your pricing power
Training: the trainer completes and posts results for every drill he assigns — only then do standards persuade
representative_figures: 丘处机（核心）
马钰（同门：分炊炼心、以清贫立信的全真首徒）
富兰克林（对照：以'十三德目'自检表公开自我修行的世俗同构）
圣方济各（对照：以赤贫示范重整教团的中世纪同构）

modes.definition_en: Long self-restraint and bodily practice are pledged as collateral for credibility: let followers and rivals alike see that you bore the cost before demanding it of others — a leader's authority comes not from preaching but from visible proof that 'I did it first'

modes.name_en: The Method of the Itinerary Record
modes.domain_zh: 把一次重大远行转化为完整的地理—风物—制度实录：行程逐日记、里程逐段算、异俗逐条录，使一次私人经历升格为公共知识——行走的终点不是抵达，而是写出可复用的档案
modes.domain_en: Turn one great journey into a complete record of geography, lands and institutions: each day logged, each stage measured, each strange custom noted — so a private experience is upgraded into public knowledge; the end of walking is not arrival but an archive others can reuse
modes.source_chapter: 弟子李志常随行记《长春真人西游记》二卷：逐日记行程、道里、山川、风俗、召对问答，为元代中亚地理与蒙初历史第一手文献
modes.key_quote_zh: 所历山川道里、风俗人情，皆记之
modes.key_quote_en: 'All the mountains and rivers passed, the stages measured, the customs and manners seen — all were set down.'
process_zh: 随行即设记录岗：远行队伍中指定专人逐日记录，行程与观察同步而非事后追忆
三层记录框架：道里里程（可复核的数据）、山川风物（地理与物产）、召对言辞（决策现场的原文）
把最难抵达的路线写实写实再写实：无人到过的路段价值最高，记录密度也最大
归后立即整理成书公开流通：让档案先于记忆衰退固化为公共文献
process_en: Station a recorder from the start: a designated hand logs each day in step with the march — not memory after the fact
A three-layer frame: distances and stages (checkable data), mountains and products (geography), the words of audiences (decision scenes verbatim)
Where the route is hardest, write it fullest: the least-traveled stretches are most valuable, and so most densely recorded
On return, compile and circulate at once: fix the archive into public literature before memory decays
representative_cases_zh: 《长春真人西游记》逐日记事：自莱州出发至大雪山往返，所记里数、驿站、山口、部族分布成为元代经营西域的地理依据
书中完整保存了与成吉思汗三次问对的问答原文：'丘祖语录'由此传世，成为研究蒙初宗教政策的原始文献
对金山、阴山一带蒙古部族生活、气候物产的白描记录，成为十四世纪初中亚民族志的孤本级材料
representative_cases_en: The Journey to the West of the Perfected Changchun logs each day from Laizhou to the Hindu Kush and back: its stage counts, stations, passes and tribal distributions served Yuan administration of the western regions
It preserves verbatim the three audiences with the khan: the 'Sayings of Master Qiu' descend from this record, a primary source for early Mongol religious policy
Its plain-sketch notes on steppe life, climate and products around the Altai and Yin Mountains remain near-unique ethnography of early fourteenth-century Central Asia
modern_applications_zh: 重大项目的'随行纪要'制度：出海开拓、跨国并购全程指定记录员，形成可交接的档案
探险与科考的日志纪律：数据（里程、坐标）+观察（风物）+决策（会议原文）三层齐备
个人经历的知识化：重大旅程或变革完成后立即成文发布，让私人经历变成行业公共资产
modern_applications_en: 'Traveling minutes' for major ventures — market entry, cross-border M&A: a designated recorder throughout, yielding a handover-ready archive
Log discipline for expeditions and research: data (stages, coordinates) + observation (terrain) + decision (verbatim meetings) in three layers
Knowledge-making of personal experience: after a great journey or transformation, write and publish at once — private experience becomes a public asset of the field
representative_figures: 丘处机（核心，李志常执笔）
法显（先行：《佛国记》纪行传统的开创者）
徐霞客（对照：以个人之力三十年纪行的极端版本）
马可·波罗（对照：口述纪行而失于核验的反面参照）

modes.name_en: The Method of the Three-Teachings Synthesis
modes.domain_zh: 不立门墙而立接口：把儒家的伦常、佛教的心性、道教的修持打通为一张可互认的教义网络——竞争性思想体系之间的出路不是驳倒对方，而是把自己改造成能容纳对方核心价值的更大框架
modes.domain_en: Raise not walls but interfaces: weld Confucian ethics, Buddhist mind-cultivation and Daoist practice into one network of mutually recognized doctrine — the way between rival systems is not to refute the other but to rebuild yourself as the larger frame that can hold the other's core values
modes.source_chapter: 全真教创教宗旨'识心见性'，融摄三教；丘处机磻溪苦修期间广交儒释，掌教后继续以三教平等态度传教；《磻溪集》中儒释道意象并用
modes.key_quote_zh: 儒释道源三教祖，由来一气判行藏
modes.key_quote_en: 'Confucian, Buddhist, Daoist — three ancestors, one source: a single breath divided into their appearances.'
process_zh: 拆解竞争体系各自不可替代的核心价值：儒之伦常、释之心性、道之养炼，逐项辨认
在自己框架内为对方核心价值留出位置：不是引用而是结构性的容纳——立'识心见性'为宗旨即同时收摄释儒
以跨体系的公共话语传教：诗词、格言、善行，用三家共赏的媒介绕开门户之辨
在制度上保持开放：儒生、释子皆可入道，以人的流动替代教义的对抗
process_en: Dissect each rival system for its irreplaceable core: Confucian ethics, Buddhist mind-nature, Daoist refinement — item by item
Make structural room for the other's core inside your own frame: not quotation but lodging — taking 'know the mind, see the nature' as the school's aim gathers both Buddhism and Confucianism at once
Teach in cross-system common media: poems, maxims, good deeds — channels all three traditions savor, bypassing sectarian dispute
Keep the institution open: Confucians and monks alike may enter the way — mobility of persons instead of combat of doctrines
representative_cases_zh: 全真立教即以《道德经》《孝经》《般若心经》为开门三经：道立其体、儒立其伦、释立其心，弟子入门须同读三教经典
丘处机《磻溪集》大量以儒家伦理劝世、以禅语说心性：为不同背景的听众预备不同的'入教通道'
西行论道时对以马上得天下的成吉思汗不讲玄理而讲'敬天爱民'——用儒家政治伦理作为与草原权力对话的接口
representative_cases_en: Quanzhen from its founding held the Daodejing, the Classic of Filial Piety and the Heart Sutra as its three gatebooks: the Dao sets the substance, Confucianism the ethics, Buddhism the mind — novices read all three
His Panxi Collection exhorts often in Confucian ethics and speaks of mind in Chan idiom: different channels of entry prepared for audiences of different backgrounds
Before a khan who had conquered on horseback he spoke no occult arcana but 'revere heaven, love the people' — Confucian statecraft as the interface for dialogue with steppe power
modern_applications_zh: 竞争性技术标准之争：把对手协议的合理部分做成自家框架的接口，让对手的用户'零成本迁移'
跨部门整合：不争论彼此方法论优劣，先在更高目标下建'互认词典'，让各方核心关切都被上层框架承认
个人知识体系：主动为对立学派的洞见留结构性位置（如把对手的直觉主义纳入自己的分析框架作约束项）
modern_applications_en: Contending technical standards: make the rival protocol's sound parts interfaces of your own frame, so its users migrate at zero cost
Cross-team integration: skip the debate over whose method wins; build a mutual-recognition lexicon under a higher aim so every side's core concern is honored by the larger frame
Personal knowledge systems: reserve structural room for the rival school's insight — fold the other's intuitionism into your analytic frame as a constraint term

modes.name_en: The Method of Rotating Mountain Seats
modes.domain_zh: 以多据点轮驻代替单点驻守：核心人物在磻溪、龙门、栖霞、燕京等各处轮转修行与传教，让每个山头都沾染过'真人亲驻'的教团记忆，再以宫观网络把据点连成面——组织的扩张靠据点轮转而非单点深耕
modes.domain_en: Rotate among many seats instead of holding one: the master turns practice and preaching across Panxi, Dragon Gate, Qixia, Yanjing and more, so every mountain bears the memory of his living presence, then joins the seats into a web of abbeys — expansion by rotation among nodes, not deepening a single node
modes.source_chapter: 1168-1174磻溪、龙门苦修；1188年应金世宗召赴中都；1191年归栖霞建太虚观；1224年居燕京太极宫（长春宫）——关键节点各有驻场
modes.key_quote_zh: 海上七真，分迹四方；一处香火，处处道场
modes.key_quote_en: 'The seven perfected of the sea scatter their traces to the four quarters: incense kindled in one place, a sanctuary everywhere.'
process_zh: 在战略要地各立一据点：修行地、政治中心、故里祖庭分别选址，功能分工明确
核心人物轮驻各点：让每个据点都获得'真人亲临'的记忆资产，避免中心对边缘的虹吸
据点之间以人事网络相连：弟子分驻各地、定期互访，保持教义与做法的一致性
时机成熟时把网络中心迁往新政治中心：金之中都、蒙古之燕京，组织心脏跟随权力重心迁移
process_en: Plant a seat in each strategic place — practice ground, political center, native home — with clear division of function
Rotate the master among them: each seat gains the memory-asset of his living presence, avoiding the center siphoning the periphery
Link the seats by a web of persons: disciples stationed about, mutual visits at intervals, keeping doctrine and practice uniform
When the hour ripens, move the network's heart to the new political center: Jin's Zhongdu, then Mongol Yanjing — the organization's heart follows power's center of gravity
representative_cases_zh: 磻溪（关中）与龙门（陇州）苦修奠定关陇根基，归后回栖霞建太虚观巩固山东祖庭：东西两大根据地分立
1188年应金世宗召赴中都主持万春节醮事：提前在金政治中心布点，为后来蒙古时代留接口
1224年后以燕京长春宫为总本山，山东、关中、河北宫观纳为一体：全真四大宗坛格局在丘处机手中成形
representative_cases_en: Ascetic years at Panxi (in Guanzhong) and Dragon Gate (Longzhou) rooted the school in the west; his return to Qixia to found the Taixu Abbey secured the Shandong homeland: two base regions standing apart
In 1188 he answered Emperor Shizong's summons to Zhongdu for the Long Spring Festival rites: a foothold planted early in Jin's political center, an interface saved for the Mongol age to come

After 1224 the Changchun Palace in Yanjing became the head mountain, drawing the abbeys of Shandong, Guanzhong and Hebei into one body: the pattern of Quanzhen's four great altars took shape in his hands
modern_applications_zh: 连锁组织的'创始人轮店'：核心人物定期驻场各区域，把'亲驻记忆'分给每个据点
跨国团队的节点布局：研发、市场、政关分别选址，跟随行业权力重心迁移总部功能
开源基金会治理：多处仪式性活动轮值举办，社区记忆分散沉淀而非垄断于单一公司
modern_applications_en: Founders' rotation in a chain: core leaders periodically sit in each region, distributing 'presence memory' to every node
Node layout for multinationals: R&D, market and government relations sited apart; headquarters functions migrate with the industry's center of gravity
Foundation governance for open source: ceremonial events rotate host cities, letting community memory settle broadly rather than pool in one company

王重阳（先行：山东化度七真的多点布道）

星巴克早期扩张团队（同构：据点轮驻式扩张的商组织同构）

modes.domain_zh: 以长期止语、静坐与梦境记录做'心的审计'：对外部论辩保持克制，把认知资源转向对念头起灭的逐日清点——用内省数据替代外部争论，先修定己心再判断外事
modes.domain_en: Long silence, seated stillness and dream records serve as an audit of the mind: restraint in outward debate, cognitive resources turned to a daily inventory of each thought's rise and fall — introspective data replacing outward contention; settle one's own mind first, then judge the world
modes.source_chapter: 磻溪六年'战睡魔'、炼心性；全真'真功真行'并重，功在明心、行在济世；丘处机教导弟子以'清心寡欲'为本
modes.key_quote_zh: 清心寡欲，一念之善皆天堂
modes.key_quote_en: 'Purify the heart, few the desires — one good thought is heaven itself.'
process_zh: 以止语切断无谓的言语输出：话少则念显，让平时被言语掩盖的心念活动显形
静坐中逐念清点：不加评判地记录念头的来去，区分'欲念'与'正念'的比例
以梦境做潜意识的对账：把梦里反复出现的场景当作白天未察觉的心结线索
先定后断：重大判断前强制一段静默期，用'心是否清'检验'判断是否准'
process_en: Cut idle speech with silence: fewer words, thoughts stand exposed — what talk concealed now shows itself
In stillness, inventory each thought: record their coming and going without judging, tell the share of desire from the share of right mindfulness
Reconcile with dreams: scenes recurring in sleep are clues to knots unnoticed by day
Settle before you judge: before a major decision impose a silence, testing 'is the judgment right' by 'is the mind clear'
representative_cases_zh: 磻溪六年与'睡魔'作战：以减睡对治昏沉，把修行做成对身心状态昼夜不停的监测
掌教后给弟子的教学以'清心'为先：面对教团事务纷争，先各自静心再议事——把内审作为组织决策的前置工序
西行万里途中照常坐炼：在军帐与马背间保持静坐功课，重大召对前必有静默准备
representative_cases_en: Six years at Panxi at war with the 'demon of sleep': he curbed slumber to master dullness, turning cultivation into round-the-clock monitoring of body and mind
As master he taught 'purify the heart' first: in the school's quarrels, each party stills the mind before the meeting — inward audit as a pre-procedure of organizational decision
On the ten-thousand-li march he kept his seated practice: amid army tents and horseback, stillness before every great audience
modern_applications_zh: 高管'决策前静默'制度：重大决议前24小时禁止拉群辩论，各自写下独立判断再合议
个人认知管理：用念头日志统计'担忧类'与'行动类'念头的比例，把焦虑变成数据
谈判与交易前的梦境与情绪自查：心绪浑浊时主动延期，'心里乱'是'判断差'的前置信号
modern_applications_en: Executive 'silence before decision': no group-chat debate 24 hours before a major call; each writes an independent judgment, then they convene
Personal cognition: a thought-log tracking the ratio of worry-thoughts to action-thoughts — anxiety made into data
Self-audit of mood and dreams before negotiation: when the mind is turbid, postpone — 'inner chaos' is the leading indicator of 'bad judgment'
representative_figures: 丘处机（核心）
王重阳（先行：以'活死人墓'闭关炼心的创教实验）
马库斯·奥勒留（对照：《沉思录》式的帝王内省）
卡内曼（对照：以实验数据替代内省的现代分野——提醒内省法之限）
modes.definition_zh: 以长期止语、静坐与梦境记录做'心的审计'：对外部论辩保持克制，把认知资源转向对念头起灭的逐日清点——用内省数据替代外部争论，先修定己心再判断外事
modes.definition_en: Long silence, seated stillness and dream records serve as an audit of the mind: restraint in outward debate, cognitive resources turned to a daily inventory of each thought's rise and fall — introspective data replacing outward contention; settle one's own mind first, then judge the world

modes.name_en: The Method of Credibility by Good Works
modes.domain_zh: 在垄断话语权的高墙（宫廷、科举、寺院经藏）之外，以可见的善举作为传播的主媒介：赈济、医疗、修桥、收孤——每一件善行都是一次'教义的可执行演示'，让不识字的人也能'读懂'教门
modes.domain_en: Outside the walled monopolies of discourse — court, examinations, monastic libraries — visible good works become the chief medium of transmission: relief, healing, bridges, taking in orphans — every good deed a 'demonstration of doctrine in action', so even the unlettered can 'read' the teaching
modes.source_chapter: 山东招抚、饥年赈济、收容战乱流民；掌教后广行善举，全真宫观普遍施药、施粥；《元史》称其'悯兵革之屡兴，念生民之涂炭'
modes.key_quote_zh: 悯兵革之屡兴，念生民之涂炭，往往为帝王言，欲使四海之内皆得遂其生
modes.key_quote_en: 'Grieved that war rose again and again, mindful of the people's misery, he spoke often to emperors, that all within the four seas might live out their lives.'
process_zh: 识别目标人群的'不可及媒介'：对不识字的流民，文字教义无效，行动才是语言
把核心教义翻译成可参与的善举：'敬天爱民'落为施粥、施药、收孤、止杀请命
让受益者成为传播节点：被救者口耳相传，善举的传播半径随救援半径同步扩张
对权力者也用同一语言：进言止杀本身就是'善举'的顶级形式——一言活万人
process_en: Find the medium your audience cannot reach: for the unlettered refugee, written doctrine fails — action is the language
Translate core doctrine into participable works: 'revere heaven, love the people' lands as porridge, medicine, orphanage, pleas to spare the killed
Let the rescued become the nodes: word passes mouth to mouth; the reach of the message grows with the radius of relief
Speak the same language to power: counsel to spare the slaughter is good works in its highest form — one word, ten thousand lives
representative_cases_zh: 1214年招抚登州不战而定：一次'善举式政教'的公开演示，金廷与百姓同时看见了全真教的组织信用
饥年率宫观施粥施药、收留孤儿：全真宫观成为山东、河北民间的事实救济网络——'善名'先于'教义'抵达人心
西行论道以'止杀'为核心进言并常年持玺书救俘：归燕后凡遇将帅必劝不杀，一言所活不可胜计
representative_cases_en: The pacification of Dengzhou in 1214 without battle: a public demonstration of good-works governance in which Jin officials and commoners alike saw the Quanzhen school's organizational credit
In famine years his abbeys ladled porridge, dispensed medicine, took in orphans: Quanzhen abbeys became the de facto relief network of Shandong and Hebei — the good name arriving before the doctrine
The western audiences put 'spare the slaughter' at the core, and with the sealed letter he ransomed captives for years: to every general he urged not killing — lives saved beyond count
modern_applications_zh: 品牌传播的'善举前置'：新市场先做可见的公益基建（修路、供水、奖学金），广告随善后至
开发者生态冷启动：先免费修复社区里骂声最大的 bug——一次'可执行的善意'胜过十场发布会
危机公关：不解释、先救援，把'立场声明'改为'可核验的救助行动清单'
modern_applications_en: Good works before advertising: in a new market, build visible public goods first — roads, water, scholarships; ads follow relief
Cold-start of a developer ecosystem: fix the community's loudest bugs free — one executable kindness beats ten launch events
Crisis PR: no explanations, rescue first — replace the 'statement of position' with a verifiable list of relief actions
representative_figures: 丘处机（核心）
张仲景（先行：'上以疗君亲、下以救贫贱'的医者济世范式）
特蕾莎修女（对照：以善举为传播主媒介的二十世纪同构）
涩泽荣一（同构：以'论语与算盘'把伦理做成经济行动）

modes.name_en: The Method of the After-Life Trust
modes.domain_zh: 在生前把'身后之事'当作制度问题求解：领赏时求政策而非财货（蠲免赋税、宫观自治），把一代人的荣宠兑换成可跨代执行的制度安排——个人生命有限，唯有制度能把一句进言的效力延到百年之后
modes.domain_en: Solve the question of 'after me' as an institutional problem while still alive: for rewards seek policy, not treasure — tax remission, abbey self-rule — exchanging one generation's favor for arrangements that outlast it; a life is finite, only institutions can carry one spoken word a hundred years onward
modes.source_chapter: 1223年东归时辞金帛虎符之赐而请蠲免道人赋役；成吉思汗诏'僧道皆免差发税赋'，并命丘处机掌管天下出家人；1227年卒前以尹志平嗣掌教
modes.key_quote_en: 'I ask not for gold but that those of the way be spared corvée and tax.'
process_zh: 受赏时刻预设'兑换清单'：把帝王感激的峰值兑换成最耐用的资产——免税、自治、传教权，而非金银田宅
把特许权落到书面：玺书、诏令、度牒制度，使'荣宠'脱离在位者肉身而独立存续
提前安排继承人并让其历练：退休前让嗣任者实际主持大事，交接是过程不是事件
以纪行与语录固化话语遗产：让后世对'祖师说过什么'有可查的文本，防止教义随口耳失真
process_en: Prepare a redemption list for the hour of reward: exchange the khan's gratitude at its peak for the most durable assets — tax exemption, self-rule, the right to preach — not gold or estates
Land each charter in writing: sealed letters, edicts, ordination institutions, so 'favor' survives apart from the giver's mortal body
Prepare and school the successor early: let the heir actually run great affairs before retirement — handover as process, not event
Fix the spoken heritage in itinerary records and sayings: future generations hold checkable texts of 'what the master said', so doctrine does not decay by ear
representative_cases_zh: 东归辞谢重赐，惟请'免道人差发赋税'：这一纸蠲免让此后数十年全真宫观在战乱与赋役间保有生存余裕
掌管'天下出家人'的任命使全真从一派升格为管理架构：制度性地位不随丘处机肉身而终结
1227年临终前指定尹志平嗣教，此前尹志平已长期代理教务；随行弟子李志常的《西游记》与语录整理，让'长春真人'的言语也成为制度资产
representative_cases_en: On his eastern return he declined rich gifts, asking only 'that the people of the Way be spared corvée and tax': one paper of remission gave Quanzhen abbeys decades of margin between war and levy
The appointment as head of 'all men of religion under heaven' raised Quanzhen from one school to an administrative office: an institutional rank that did not die with him
Before his death in 1227 he named Yin Zhiping heir, long schooled in the school's affairs; Li Zhichang's Journey and the collected sayings fixed the master's words as institutional assets
modern_applications_zh: 创始人退休设计：不套现最大的股权激励，而是把影响力兑换成'章程修订权'与治理条款
关键谈判的遗产条款：在对方最感激的时刻要'写入协议的长期权利'（独家、续约权、治理席位）
知识传承制度化：一手经验写成手册与案例库并署名可查，让个人智慧在离职后继续执行
modern_applications_en: Founder retirement design: cash not the greatest equity grant but trade influence for 'charter revision rights' and governance clauses
Legacy clauses in key negotiations: at the moment of the other side's greatest gratitude, ask for long-term rights written into the agreement — exclusivity, renewal, a governance seat
Institutionalize knowledge transfer: firsthand experience written into manuals and case libraries, signed and searchable, so personal wisdom keeps executing after departure
